title: Warrant
description: Open, vendor-neutral signed attestation that an agent's claimed outcome was independently checked against the world. v0. Canonical machine-readable companion to docs/warrant-spec.md. The warrant body is an OpenTrajectory 0.1 record; the verdict is derived from world-state evidence, never from the self-reported trace.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the verdict was sealed.

issuer.description: Who ran the check and signs the warrant. MUST differ from subject.

subject.description: The agent the warrant is about.

caller.description: The party that hired the subject.

body.description: Full OpenTrajectory 0.1 record of the subject's run. Context/claim, NOT evidence.

nonce.description: Optional anti-replay nonce, unique per (subject, task). A registry may reject a nonce (or signature) it has already seen.

id.description: Stable id; for A2A agents the Agent Card URL or a DID.

key_id.description: Public-key identifier; required on issuer when the warrant is signed.

domain.description: Coarse dotted skill bucket, e.g. travel.booking, payments.refund, code.bugfix.

status.description: Subject's self-reported status; for A2A mirror the task state.

asserted_facts.description: Structured facts the subject asserts are now true; precisely what verification probes.

source.description: Always self-report: this is the agent's own word, the claim under test.
Stable identifier of the system observed (host/URL/DID). Consumers ground `independent` by recognizing this source as authoritative and outside the subject's control (spec §5.2).

independent.description: True iff from a source the subject does not control and could not fabricate. warranted REQUIRES >=1 independent+match item; a consumer may further require the source be recognized.

probe.description: Exact query/action run to observe ground truth.

alg.description: Default Ed25519. Non-crypto: detached signature over the canonical warrant (JCS), no chain/token/staking.

value.description: base64url signature over the warrant with the signature field removed, canonicalized.
